authorship: Original synthetic educational fixtures, runners, validators, schemas, tests, templates, and guides authored for the aicourse.top repository.
method: The foundation fixture contains twelve manually authored 4x4 line grids. The visual fixture declares an original deterministic 8x8 line-pattern generator and inverted-contrast transfer domain. The sequence fixture declares two original symbolic cycles and four short multilingual tokenizer probes. The PyTorch runner executes tiny CPU models against only those fixtures. No personal data, scraped corpus, external dataset, pretrained model weights, paper figure, notebook, assignment, or third-party source code is redistributed.

rights.reuse: Original repository material; reuse is governed by the repository licence. Linked PyTorch, NumPy, papers, and documentation retain their own terms.

humanReview.boundary: Automated generation and validation do not satisfy the named-human terminology, semantic-fidelity, or technical-accuracy release review.
